column1: # THE WHAT-IF's RULE ROOTS (scripts/identity_what_if.py select): a definition of identity/src/main/scala and the rule ids
# (DecisionTrace.rulesOf, `*` any run) a change to it can move. A change is walked up its callers until each path ends in a
# root; a path past every root selects ALL families. A root's patterns name every take its rule decides AND every take it
# could start deciding: its own accept / pooled / refused ids (a node no rule took alone records each alone rule's refusal)
# and the accept ids of the rules after it in Acceptance.aloneRules / pooledRules' order, which it would pre-empt.
# A root is sound only if its rule's evaluation reaches no take but through those ids; --verify checks a run of it.
